cards.text: What is something you want more of in your life right now that you haven't made space for?
Describe a moment when your perspective on something important completely shifted.
What is the question you most often ask yourself when you're alone?
Tell the group what you think the most overrated thing in modern life is.
What is something you are still figuring out about yourself?
Describe a version of your life that might have existed if one decision had gone differently.
What is the thing you most want to be remembered for?
Tell the group something you once wanted badly that you no longer want at all.
What is one thing you wish people understood about you without you having to explain it?
Describe the last time you felt completely at peace with where you are in life.
What is a value you hold that most shapes the decisions you make?
Tell the group what you think happens after we die, honestly.
What is the most meaningful conversation you've had in the last year?
Describe what home means to you right now, beyond a physical place.
Tell the group what you think the hardest part of being human is.
What is something you forgave yourself for that took a long time?
Describe a relationship in your life that has changed you the most.
What is something you used to be certain about that you are now genuinely unsure of?
Tell the group what you think the difference is between being happy and being fulfilled.
What is a fear you've actually overcome, even partially?
Tell the group something that used to drain you that no longer does.
Describe a time when doing the right thing was the harder choice.
What is something about the world you find genuinely beautiful that most people overlook?
Tell the group what you think your greatest personal strength actually costs you.
What is a choice you made out of fear that turned out fine?
Describe the most important thing you've learned about yourself in the last two years.
What do you think you would regret most if you never tried it?
Tell the group one thing you know to be true about what makes a good life.
Describe a moment when someone changed your mind about something you held tightly.
What is the thing you most want to say to someone you haven't said it to yet?
